name: @local/dsh-ac-boot
description: A deep-space cinematic tactical-briefing boot sequence for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. v12 makes the run launch-scoped: it plays when the application starts and never replays on wake from sleep, tray restore or a page reload (a sessionStorage launch flag also lets the Host drop the pre-boot splash before first paint on those reloads). v11 raises the map's dark/light contrast: darker relief land, a nonlinear session heat scale making low-occupancy regions nearly black and high-occupancy regions bright cyan, with the primary workspace in magenta; multi-node rays and links still light the network before the territory fills. The client module now carries a build fingerprint: a hot module reload (DSH plugin refresh / Unlag reload) replays the sequence in the same window without a full app restart; Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B or window.__ACB_REPLAY replays manually. The right information columns are gone; the map is full-bleed with the left intel column floating over it; the reveal is a white-hot flash, wide bloom, anamorphic streak and bright coastline after a 45°-to-top-down move. v8 supplies the live Host workspace snapshot and /acb/workspaces route; v7-v6 the deep tonal hierarchy, spatial field and light rig; plus the holographic logo uplink, briefing console, operator login and title HUD.
